rollback.sql: DELETE FROM `tenantservice`.`tenant_dpa_signature` WHERE tenant_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM `tenantservice`.`tenant`); -- The previous binary's DpaSignatureStatus knows only PENDING/SIGNED/DENIED, so a -- surviving INVALIDATED row would break enum conversion the next time that -- tenant's signature list is read. These rows are withdrawn invitations, never -- evidence (an INVALIDATED row was by definition never signed), so they are -- deleted rather than translated - mapping them to DENIED would falsely claim the -- agreement was refused and would arm the 365-day deactivation retention. DELETE FROM `tenantservice`.`tenant_dpa_signature` WHERE signature_status = 'INVALIDATED'; ALTER TABLE `tenantservice`.`tenant_dpa_signature` ADD CONSTRAINT fk_tenant_dpa_signature_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES `tenantservice`.`tenant` (id) ON DELETE CASCADE;
